newsitem.title: CHINA: CHANG'AN FIRST HALF NET 126 MLN YUAN.
newsitem.headline: CHANG'AN FIRST HALF NET 126 MLN YUAN.

text.p: Chongqing Changan Automobile Co Ltd notched up net profits of 125.91 million yuan on sales of 1.43 billion yuan in the first half of 1997, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Per-share net reached 0.144 yuan, with net assets valued at 2.68 yuan per share at the end of June this year, the exchange said in a notice issued after the market closed.
The exchange did not give any comparative figures or state whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.

The company, one of China's leading mini sedan car makers, posted net profits of 82.628 million yuan on sales of 1.085 billion yuan for the first half of 1996 under international accounting standards.
The company's 1996 interim results using Chinese standards were not available.
